data.name: Murawwah
data.gender_notes: Murawwah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘murawwah’, meaning ‘desirable’, ‘pleasing’ or ‘lovely’. In Islamic history, Murawwah is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for her noble character and strong faith. The name Murawwah carries the meaning “Desirable, Pleasing, Lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murawwah usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, pleasing, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner beauty and admirable qualities that make a person desirable and worthy of respect and love.
data.etymology: Murawwah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desirable, Pleasing, Lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murawwah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
